description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/ppm_flux_D_lev_mono_hybrid_noflux_bc -- the TERRAIN-FOLLOWING (hybrid sigma-pressure) upwind-biased, monotone, conservative flux-form vertical advection operator. Two structural differences from the fixed-grid ppm_flux_D_lev_mono_noflux_bc golden are pinned here: (1) MASS FORM -- each of the seven regions lowers to the RAW face-flux difference F_{k+1/2} - F_{k-1/2} with NO trailing division by a cell thickness (the fixed-grid golden divides every region by dz[.,.,k]); this is what keeps the vertical divergence conservative when the layers move. (2) TERRAIN-FOLLOWING RECONSTRUCTION -- the CW84 parabola widths are gathered from the RANK-3 physical thickness dp[i,j,k+/-n] (the grid's lev_thickness_3d applied to a 3-D pe = Ap + Bp*Ps), not a 1-D column dz[k], so dp is indexed on [lon,lat,lev] throughout. Everything else -- the compound match D(W*q, wrt: lev) firing at priority 10, the seven regions (interior [4, NLEV-3], surface k=1,2,3, top k=NLEV-2,NLEV-1,NLEV), the branch-free max/min upwind donor selection with DIFFERENT aR_L / aL_R operands, and the wall fluxes being absent (never W[i,j,1] or W[i,j,NLEV+1]) -- matches the fixed-grid sibling. NLEV = 7 is the smallest grid exercising all seven regions with a non-empty interior.
